seasons.name: Cool season
seasons.nameKm: រដូវត្រជាក់
seasons.arrival: A dry chill settles at dusk. Nights bite now, so keep a fire close. The fish are slow to rise.
seasons.description: Cold nights outside shelter or fire. Fish bite slowly. Hunger slightly higher.

seasons.name: Hot season
seasons.arrival: The air shimmers and the pools shrink. Your throat is dry by noon. Berries are thin, but fish crowd the water.
seasons.description: Thirst up. Berries and herbs scarcer. Fish bite sooner. More wildlife about.

seasons.name: Rainy season
seasons.arrival: Green smell of wet earth. Water is easy to find, herbs and shoots push up, and fewer creatures stir.
seasons.description: Thirst down. Herbs and bamboo shoots plentiful. Fish bite slowly. Fewer creatures.
